heading: City of Corona Water Utility, California, water recycling and reuse project

tree.heading: Authorization
tree.text: The Secretary, in cooperation with the City of Corona Water Utility, California, is authorized to participate in the design, planning, and construction of, and land acquisition for, a project to reclaim and reuse wastewater, including degraded groundwaters, within and outside of the service area of the City of Corona Water Utility, California.

tree.heading: Cost share
tree.text: The Federal share of the cost of the project authorized by this section shall not exceed 25 percent of the total cost of the project.

tree.heading: Limitation
tree.text: The Secretary shall not provide funds for the operation and maintenance of the project authorized by this section.

sourceCredit: (Pub. L. 102–575, title XVI, § 1656, as added Pub. L. 111–11, title IX, § 9114(a), Mar. 30, 2009, 123 Stat. 1320.)
